newsitem.title: USA: Vacation Break Jim Lambert, end pact.
newsitem.headline: Vacation Break Jim Lambert, end pact.

text.p: Vacation Break U.S.A said Wednesday its agreement to acquire various entities owned by Jim Lambert has been terminated by mutual agreement of the parties but that the company will continue to investigate possible acquisitions.

"We will continue to investigate possible acquisitions, including acquiring the Lambert entities' minority interest in our joint venture properties," said president Kevin Sheehan. "Vacation Break continues to have a strong business plan that includes capitalizing on the marketing diversification we have achieved, our continued operating efficiency and an aggressive acquisition and development strategy. We expect to announce positive operating results for the first quarter, which will be the foundation for our continued growth."

"We're disappointed that things didn't work out," said chairman and chief executive Ralph Muller. "In the course of our due diligence investigation, we became aware that the results of the acquisition might not be as attractive as originally anticipated. We were also concerned about the effect of regulatory trends in the states that might have a potential negative effect on the sales and marketing programs they conduct with respect to Williamsburg and Westview, the Lambert Properties we were to acquire."
